ToM is a significant mediator between neurocognition (NC) and functioning in a young psychiatric sample with a wide range of psychiatric diagnoses and psychosis-risk status.

1) in a young psychiatric sample ToM mediates neurocognition and social functioning, and this mediation effect is independent of the level and the diagnosis of psychosis risk, and 2) the mediation model is complete, as the effect of neuro cognition on functioning is no longer significant when ToM is added to the model.

the identification of a neurocognitive and ToM-based pathway of functional outcome that is independent of psychosis risk and diagnosis.
a specific mediation model that has been previously tested only in the field of PSDs.
the identification of specific cognitive deficits in the early stages of the disorder, which are related to functional disability, in order to develop targeted interventions.
